description: OHLCV candles for a Solana token (by mint, or SOL/BTC/ETH) or a specific pool from GeckoTerminal: minute (1, 5, 15), hour (1, 4, 12) or day candles in USD, oldest first, with a summary — open, close, high and low with their times, % return, % range and total volume. A token is priced in its most-traded pool over 24h (named in the result). For SOL, BTC and ETH, falls back to Coinbase Exchange and then Kraken USD candles when GeckoTerminal is unavailable. Fails (and is not charged) if no source has candles. Costs $0.002 USDC per call.

aggregate.description: Candles per bar: minute 1, 5 or 15; hour 1, 4 or 12; day 1 (default 1)

pool.description: A specific Solana pool address instead of the token's top pool

token.description: Solana token mint address, or SOL, BTC or ETH. Its most-traded pool is used
